title: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
content: Israel is planning large-scale land expropriations in historic, Palestinian areas of the West Bank.

title: Hundreds arrested over French wildfires, but who is to blame?
content: The government is trying to attribute blame for the unprecedented fires which tore through the country last month.

title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
content: Both sides suggest progress in talks to agree a new shipping route through the strait, but a breakthrough remains unclear.

title: Israel announces tender for 627 settler units in occupied West Bank
content: New settlement tender in West Bank deepens Israeli efforts to sever Palestinian ties to Jerusalem, officials warn.

title: Wildfire forces thousands of evacuations in Western Canada
content: A fast-moving wildfire has forced more than 20,000 people to evacuate parts of British Columbia’s Okanagan region.

title: Lionel Messi returns to Argentina after father Jorge’s death
content: Football star Lionel Messi returned to Argentina with his family on Saturday, a day after his father died.
